action.newText: killProcessGroup is reached through _gitDeps so fake-spawn unit tests can observe its calls without sending real signals. The POSIX integration test deliberately uses the real runtime spawn and signals only its captured git child process group and git process. Every fake-spawn test that reaches a kill must replace and restore the group-kill seam.

rationale: The helper in packages/nax-agent/src/internal/process-kill.ts really invokes process.kill(-pid, signal). This correction preserves both the required integration coverage and fake-pid safety.

target.section: Design / Failure Handling — Git exits before the kill

action.newText: Git exits before the kill: each kill call is independently caught, and kill exceptions never reject the operation or override result classification. When proc.exited is handled, a fired timeout returns { stdout: "", stderr: "", exitCode: 1, timedOut: true }; otherwise an already-aborted signal returns { stdout: "", stderr: "", exitCode: 1, aborted: true }. Neither path awaits pipe drains. If neither condition applies, return the process's stdout, stderr and exitCode unchanged. Cancellation after the result has settled does not change it.

rationale: Verified packages/nax-agent/src/internal/git-exec.ts:128-148 classifies timeout first, then an aborted signal, before reading normal output. The correction resolves the spec's internal inconsistency rather than changing its required return contract.
